title: Cubbon Park
design_goal: Meet Ananya through the phone system (a payment, a number); the first collectible set (City Moments); the curiosity hook (a cough, a wishlist, a doctor's thread).

cast.role: Sixty an hour; will not let Ananya's payment go
Phone dead, ₹60 stuck; pays back later by UPI (chat). Number exchanged opens the relationship (met → warm after the walk)
Stops, coughs, waves it off (tic: cough; jogger_cough_seen)
Guitar ₹6,500 - the display piece, booked till Tuesday → guitar_wishlisted (Notes)

beats.what: Arrival unlocks the Camera. Five photo spots - bandstand, library, bamboo grove, red building, a dog - frame themselves in the viewfinder when you stand in them; SNAP saves a City Moment. All five → cubbon_photos_done.
Ananya at the cycle rental: phone dead, ₹60 stuck. Pay (₹60) → she asks for your number → relationship opens (Contacts shows 'Met').
Optional: walk the loop. She follows; three stops (bandstand, bamboo, library steps) are three lines; the last one is her photo of you - it lands in the Camera gallery and on the save slot.
The guitar shop at the Church Street edge: ₹6,500, the display piece, Tuesday. A note appears in Notes with how far the wallet is from it.
Bus home from the park gate (₹35, 50 min). In the room the phone rings: Amma - 'the news is saying something about Bangalore'. Reels: a doctor's thread, a meme, the ward clip.
Sleep. Act 1 ends; the Dating app arrives on the phone (Act 2 starts as a stub).

assets_needed: sheets: cycle guy, Ananya, ice-cream cart, jogger, guitar shop
acceptance: arriving unlocks the Camera; standing in a photo spot frames it and SNAP saves it; five photos set cubbon_photos_done
paying Ananya's ₹60 spends through the ledger; exchanging numbers puts her in Contacts as 'Met' and opens her chat
with ananya_walk set she follows the player; the three stop zones give three lines; the last sets ananya_walk_done, her photo appears in the gallery and the relationship reads 'Friends'
the guitar cannot be bought today; the Notes app shows it with the rupees to go
back in the flat, Amma calls once; the ₹60 comes back on the ledger with Ananya's message
sleeping sets act1_done, completes the quest and unlocks the Dating app (act2_started)
